The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6fe4b337ba8c9128), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let X be a smooth projective variety of dimension n ≥ 3 with pseudo-effective KX. There are an effective ample Q-divisor B on X, an integer s ≥ 0, and a finite sequence of K-negative divisorial contractions and K-flips X 99K Y with the following properties. (i) Y is projective, Q-factorial, and terminal. The map X 99K Y extracts no divisors. (ii) Put L = KY , let BY be the transform of B, and set tj = 2−j , Mj = L + tjBY (j > s). For each j > s there is a closed subset Zj ⊂ Y of codimension at least three such that |kMj| is defined by a Cartier divisor and is base point free on Y \ Zj for every sufficiently divisible positive integer k. (iii) On a common smooth projective resolution p : W → X, q : W → Y , compatible canonical divisors satisfy (2.1) p∗ KX = q∗ KY + E, where E ≥ 0 is q-exceptional and its support contains the strict transform of every prime divisor of X contracted by X 99K Y .
